title: SOLID Principles
description: Five principles for writing maintainable, flexible, and understandable object-oriented software.

tutorials.title: Single Responsibility Principle
tutorials.description: A class should have one reason to change, meaning it should have one clear responsibility.

tutorials.title: Open Closed Principle
tutorials.description: Software entities should be open for extension but closed for modification.

tutorials.title: Liskov Substitution Principle
tutorials.description: Objects of a subclass should be replaceable for objects of its superclass without breaking the application.

tutorials.title: Interface Segregation Principle
tutorials.description: Clients should not be forced to depend on methods they do not use.

tutorials.title: Dependency Inversion Principle
tutorials.description: High-level modules should not depend on low-level modules; both should depend on abstractions.
